accountName.title: Account Name
accountName.description: Account name to resolve to AccountId for related records (not typically used for Account operations, but available for consistency)

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: For create/update: Set to false to preview only without committing. Default (true): Commits immediately. For delete: Set to true to actually delete. Default (false): Returns confirmation message first. The agent should first call delete with confirm=false, ask the user, then call again with confirm=true if confirmed.

fieldDataJson.title: Field Data JSON
fieldDataJson.description: JSON string containing Account field data. For create: {"Name":"Acme Corp","Industry":"Technology"}. For update: {"Industry":"Technology","BillingCity":"San Francisco"}. For bulk operations: [{"Name":"Acme"},{"Name":"Globex"}]. Required for create/update operations. IMPORTANT: For picklist fields (Industry, Type, etc.), query availableFieldsJson from a previous read operation to see valid values. Do NOT ask the user for picklist options - query availableFieldsJson to get them automatically.

filtersJson.title: Filters JSON
filtersJson.description: JSON string of exact-match filters for find operations. Can be single object {"fieldApiName":"Industry","value":"Technology"} or array [{"fieldApiName":"Industry","value":"Technology"}]. IMPORTANT: If the user wants to find an account but hasn't provided specific filters, ask them for details like industry, city, state, or phone number BEFORE calling this action. Do not call find operation without a searchTerm or filtersJson.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Explicit operation to perform: "create", "read", "update", "delete", or "find". If not specified, operation will be inferred from context: has fieldDataJson + recordId = update, has fieldDataJson only = create, has recordId only = read, has searchTerm/filtersJson = find, has recordId only (no data/search) = delete.

recordId.title: Record ID
recordId.description: The Salesforce record ID (15 or 18 character) of the Account. Required for read/update/delete operations. Format: 18-character ID like "001xx000003DGbYAAW". For update, can be omitted if Name is provided in fieldDataJson for automatic resolution.

searchLimit.title: Search Limit
searchLimit.description: Maximum number of records to return for find operations (default: 5, max: 20).

searchTerm.title: Search Term
searchTerm.description: Text to search for in Account fields (Name, BillingCity, BillingState, etc.). Used for find operations. Example: "Acme" or "San Francisco". IMPORTANT: If the user wants to find an account but hasn't provided a search term, ask them for the account name or other identifying information BEFORE calling this action. Do not call find operation without a searchTerm or filtersJson.
